ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Ship Vermin
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHIP_VERMIN_MOD_1 — owner ruling, 2026-09-11, verbatim: "gather all the 'ship infesting' critters together into a single mod 'ShipVermin' that allows the mechanics, creatures, and future cool ideas to emerge. Some are cute, some are hideous, some live inside, some can live outside in vaccuum (the mynock for example)." One home for every ship-infesting critter, so a future species lands here instead of spawning its own mod.
RM tier: the mechanics engine (comps, JobGivers, the alert) knows nothing species-specific — every field is attached to a species by an ordinary XML patch, driven by the shared mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors assembly. The mynock's own species def (RSW_Mynock — Star-Wars-specific content, per the naming scheme's "species vs. clan" rule) lives in mandrake.rsw.swbestiary, that mod's existing home for Star Wars creature species; this mod patches its mechanics onto that def rather than declaring an RSW_-prefixed def of its own (this mod's own defNames are RM_ per the folder's tier).
Ships: - Patches/RSW_Mynock_ShipVermin.xml — adds RM_CompVerminBreeder, RM_VerminPressureExtension (soft cap 3 / hard cap 12 per map — the "nuisance unless there are many" curve, owner-verbatim), RM_SeekTargetExtension (seekSubstructure — the vacuum-drift-to-the-hull boarding behavior; vanilla ThingDef.bringAlongOnGravship carries it home for free at launch, RimSage- verified against Gravship.ShouldBringOnGravship) and RM_GnawTargetExtension (chews CompGlower-bearing buildings and PowerConduit, strips laid floor terrain back to substructure) to RSW_Mynock. - RM_Alert_ShipVermin — concrete population alert (group tag "ShipVermin") on top of mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors' abstract base.
Vacuum: RSW_Mynock's own race stats (in SWBestiary) set canBeVacuumBurnt=false and VacuumResistance=1 so it never needs a hull, per the owner's "some can live outside in vaccuum (the mynock for example)".
Art: no bespoke mynock sprite ships yet (RSW_Mynock's graphicData points at a not-yet-populated texPath under this def's own mod — the def structure is complete, the art pass is future work per the item's own "future cool ideas" framing). This is NOT the same asset as mandrake.rsw.mynockartoverride, which retextures a DIFFERENT, donor (mlie.starwarsanimalcollection) mynock and is untouched by this item.
Live-verified 2026-09-11: mynock boards, breeds under the population cap, and gnaws power/lighting to rubble on a live bridge quicktest.
